def factor_volume_lead_coherence_vol_confidence(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy['close'].pct_change()
    vol_mean = df_copy['volume'].rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean()
    vol_surprise = df_copy['volume'] / vol_mean.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
    vol_lag1 = vol_surprise.shift(1)
    lead_corr = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=10).corr(vol_lag1)
    contemp_corr = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=10).corr(vol_surprise)
    raw_diff = lead_corr - contemp_corr
    signal = raw_diff.ewm(span=5, min_periods=1).mean()
    vol_ratio = df_copy['volume'] / vol_mean.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    vol_boost = (vol_ratio - 1.0).clip(-0.3, 0.3)
    confidence = 1.0 + vol_boost
    factor = signal * confidence
    factor = factor.fillna(0.0)
    factor.name = 'factor_volume_lead_coherence_vol_confidence'
    return factor
